title: Premise Heating and the Monthly Bill Estimate for a New Security Deposit
content:
A monthly bill estimate drawn from a sister agreement, for a Security Deposit on a new agreement still pending start, is adjusted for the way the new premise is heated. The heating of each premise is the primary space-heating source recorded on its Electric Service Agreement from the start order, electric or non-electric.

| Estimate drawn from | New premise heating | Sister premise heating | Estimate multiplied by |
|---|---|---|---|
| A sister agreement | Electric | Non-electric | 1.3 |
| A sister agreement | Non-electric | Electric | 0.8 |
| A sister agreement | Same source as the sister premise | Same source as the new premise | Taken as it is |
| The kind's default average monthly bill | Any | Any | Taken as it is |

The estimate so adjusted is rounded to the cent and is the average monthly bill recorded on the deposit.

## Cases (hypothetical estimate of USD 160.00 drawn from a sister agreement)

- New premise electric, sister premise non-electric: USD 160.00 times 1.3, which is USD 208.00.
- New premise non-electric, sister premise electric: USD 160.00 times 0.8, which is USD 128.00.
- Both electric: USD 160.00.
- Hypothetical estimate of USD 157.37, new premise electric, sister premise non-electric: USD 204.581, rounded to the cent USD 204.58.
